summary: The plan fits together except for its only boot proof: it plans a new scripts/smoke/run.mjs for BOOT-001, but this project's app-boots check is a fixed 'not set up' command and the developer guidance forbids creating that harness, so BOOT-001 still cannot be proven and the design's step 4 cannot be carried out as written.

conflicts.why: R11 (acceptance: 'Starting the app in desktop/local mode and opening the home page and reading data succeeds') and BOOT-001 are enforced by the app-boots check. The design's only boot proof is to create scripts/smoke/run.mjs, but this project's app-boots check is a fixed command that always prints 'Not set up in this project ... no scripts/smoke/run.mjs' and exits 78, and the project's own developer guidance says 'This project has no scripts/smoke harness, so do not create one or add probe files'. The design therefore tells the builder to create the one file the builder's own guidance forbids, and creating it does not enable the check: the adoption baseline says a start-up check is enabled by a separate 'devteam run "Add a start-up check that starts the app and requests its home page"' followed by 'devteam adopt refresh', neither of which is part of this feature or its scope. So the builder cannot satisfy both the design and its instructions, and BOOT-001 stays unproven.
conflicts.evidence: Design summary: 'Prove the boot requirement (BOOT-001) with a real smoke runner, added as the new file scripts/smoke/run.mjs (Node, no new packages, built-in fetch and child_process only).' Design scope: 'scripts/smoke/**'. Design component: BootSmokeRunner, path 'scripts/smoke/run.mjs'. BOOT-001: 'The app must start and work as it was set up: its home page loads, sign-in behaves as configured (none when single-user), and reading data through the web app succeeds.' .devteam/pack/pack.json, check app-boots: kind 'command', command 'echo Not set up in this project: Nothing starts the app and looks at it  no scripts/smoke/run.mjs , so nothing proves the app starts and works yet. && exit 78'. .devteam/pack/guidance/developer.md: 'DevTeam keeps its own start-up check (under .devteam): after the build it starts the app and looks at its home page. This project has no scripts/smoke harness, so do not create one or add probe files; if a feature you add cannot start or answer, the check will say so.' .devteam/adoption/baseline.md: 'The app starts and works as set up: not set up ... This is optional ... If you want it: devteam run "Add a start-up check that starts the app and requests its home page" ... After you have done any of these, run devteam adopt refresh so DevTeam looks at the project again.'
